name: Red Goblin

abilityDetails.True Sense: Bu saldırılar Otomatik Blok ve Miss etkilerini yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Energize: Muharebe Güç Oranını belirtilen güçte artırır.
abilityDetails.Fury: Saldırı gücünü geçici olarak büyük ölçüde artırır.
abilityDetails.Aptitude: Fury, Armor Up ve Precision etkilerinin gücünü artırır.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Direct Damage: Zırh ve dirençleri yok sayan doğrudan hasar verir.

howToPlay: Red Goblin için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Cosmic sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Symbiotic Empowerment
Special Attacks generate +1 Symbiote Buff with [90 - 35]% reduced Potency.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Gain full Immunity to Incinerate and Power Burn.
Red Goblin's Symbiote reduces Ability Accuracy of Passive Evade abilities for #Spider-Verse Champions by 100%.

abilitySections.title: Persistent Bloodlust - Max 5
content: After Winning a Fight, gain 1 Bloodlust  for the remainder of the Quest. If defeating a #Spider-Verse Champion, gain +1 Bloodlust.
Lose 1 Bloodlust when defeated.

abilitySections.title: Frenzy
content: While the Opponent has less than 15% health remaining, activate Frenzy. Each Bloodlust increases this threshold by a flat 10%, reaching 65% at max Bloodlust.
Frenzy also triggers a True Sense Buff bypassing the effects of Miss and Auto Block. If Frenzy ends, this Buff is removed.
Gain [1,363.95] Attack Rating. Additionally gain [1,363.95] Attack Rating for each Bloodlust. Each stack suffers from 15% reduced Potency

abilitySections.title: Special Activation - Symbiote Buffs
content: Activating Special Attacks creates a Buff based on the last attack launched. Buffs last for 15 seconds but start Paused. Buffs are unpaused the next time one of them is triggered.
Light Attack: Energize, granting 25% Combat Power Rate. Aptitudes increase the Potency of these Energize Buffs by 75%.
Medium Attack: Fury, granting [5,455.8] Attack Rating.
Heavy Attack: Aptitude, granting 120% increased Fury, Precision, and Armor Up Potency.

abilitySections.title: Carnage Bombs - Heavy Attacks and Special 2
content: Each Energize Buff inflicts Power Drain, draining 10% max Power over 15 seconds.
Each Fury Buff inflicts inflicts Armor Break, reducing Armor by [687.5] for 15 seconds.
All other Buffs inflict Incinerate, dealing [15,912.75] Energy Damage over 15 seconds. Incinerate also prevents Perfect Block and reduces Block Proficiency by -50%.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: Carnage Bomb Debuffs inflicted by this attack have 65% reduced Duration.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Symbiote Attacks: All 5 hits deal a burst of direct damage equal to 100% damage dealt. Potency increased by 100% for each Unique Debuff on the Opponent.
Shrapnel Blast: Incinerate, dealing [13,639.5] Energy Damage over 20 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: Carnage Bombs: Inflict Carnage Bomb Debuffs.
After Burner: All 3 hits deal a burst of [9,093] energy damage.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: Activate Frenzy for 30 seconds.
Inflict 7 Random Carnage Bomb Debuffs with 50% increased Duration.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Symbiotic Empowerment
content: Special Attacks generate +1 Symbiote Buff with [90 - 35]% reduced Potency.
